Transform coordinates

Source: R/rproj.R
rproj_xy.Rd

Forward-transform a two-column matrix of coordinates with PROJ. Authority codes are axis-normalized, so input is always x,y (lon,lat) order and output is easting,northing - even for 'EPSG:4326'.

Usage

rproj_xy(x, target, ..., source = NULL)

Arguments

x

two-column matrix of coordinates in source

target

output coordinate system (anything PROJ accepts)

...

ignored

source

input coordinate system, default 'EPSG:4326' (axis-normalized, so input is lon,lat regardless of authority order)

Value

two-column matrix of transformed coordinates

Details

Points outside the domain of target are returned as NA rather than raising an error.

Examples

rproj_xy(cbind(147, -42), "+proj=laea +lon_0=147 +lat_0=-42")
#>      x y
#> [1,] 0 0
